name: Valorous Champion grants attack power and Strength-derived spell hit rating natively (#1045)
contract: Spell.dbc 804339 ("Valorous Champion", SpellFamilyName 33, self-targeted) effect 0 is SPELL_AURA_MOD_ATTACK_POWER_PCT (166) with EffectBasePoints 24 (amount 25); AuraEffect::HandleAuraModAttackPowerPercent (SpellAuraEffects.cpp:231) calls target->SetStatPctModifier(UNIT_MOD_ATTACK_POWER, TOTAL_PCT, GetTotalAuraMultiplier(...)), a pure native stat-percent modifier, so total attack power becomes exactly 1.25x the unbuffed value. Effect 1 is SPELL_AURA_MOD_RATING_FROM_STAT (220) with EffectBasePoints 4 (amount 5), EffectMiscValue 128 = 1<<7 = CR_HIT_SPELL, and EffectMiscValueB 0 = STAT_STRENGTH — the same native Player::UpdateRating path (PlayerUpdates.cpp:650-661) as Solar Discernment, granting spell hit rating equal to 5% of Strength; the raw amount (5) is pinned directly via aura_amount since the scenario validator only allows relative_to/ratio_to between snapshots of the same metric. Both are generic engine paths already wired into the AuraEffect handler table; no server script exists or is needed.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Sanity: no baseline spell hit rating on a fresh character
Attack power is exactly 1.25x the unbuffed value
Spell hit rating amount is exactly 5% of Strength (SPELL_AURA_MOD_RATING_FROM_STAT amount)
